snippet.title: Throttle Trace | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
MicroProse and Unordered Games announce Throttle Trace — a racing sim that strips it back to what matters most. throttle. brake. every corner counts.

No steering. Just pure speed management. Beneath the simple controls lies a deep simulation - tire wear, fuel load, aerodynamics, track evolution, and dynamic AI drivers that race like real competitors.

Build your career, earn your reputation, and leave your mark on the racing world.

🏁 Wishlist Throttle Trace on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4535730/Throttle_Trace/
